eligibility.players: Explicit ownership traits feed original both-player exclusion
eligibility.fallback: Original ai_enemy fallback faction10 retained for out-of-range IDs; unequal IDs never imply enemies

geometry.reach: Calls original dh2_attack_melee_radius with resolved AI property1, original fallback row8, actual main ItemRecord word39, and original ranged type4/5 handling
geometry.target_radius: Returns original target melee reach, not physical-body collision radius
geometry.distance: Calls original dh2_attack_melee_distance: strictly (ownerReach+targetReach)^2 > 3D squared distance; exact boundary excluded

registry: std::map stable addresses across insertion; duplicates rejected; remove clears other actors' target references; clear drops registry/events while retaining source bindings and RNG state
